editionLabel: Board&Dice English Architecture of the Universe rulebook
firstPlayerRule: The player who can name the most of Jupiter's moons takes the first turn. Alternatively, choose the starting player by any random method.
clarifications: Players first state how many moons they can name, then name them in any order.
After each turn, play passes to the left.

sources.title: Exoplanets Rules — Architecture of the Universe English edition
